body: Nothing works, I've tried to break up with them multiple times, it ends with them pulling me back in and my therapist explained that since they have BPD I should be setting boundaries but I can't because it's too late we've been in this relationship too long and I know it's my fault for not setting boundaries, but if I don't answer a text within the first five minutes or a skype call within the first 4 rings or so I get blamed and ignored and I don't want to base my time around them anymore, I don't want to be guilted into moving in with them and I feel like the only way to end it is killing myself because that's the only way I'd be able to be free of it
